title.narrative: Youth Skills Development and Economic Empowerment

description.narrative: This project will promote economic and social empowerment and participation of young people addressing issues of youth employment and skills development, ensuring young people are equipped with the tools to effectively contribute to the development of their countries.? The project will focus on the emergence of new sectors, particularly those driven by advances in digital technology and in response to climate change.? The project will enhance employability by prioritising soft skills such as self-confidence, teamwork, and communications. The project will also address the prevailing issue of skills mismatching by promoting on-the-job learning through quality apprenticeships as well as better aligning educational systems, technical vocational and education and training (TVET) and industries to ensure young people are being provided the skills required to secure employment. In addition, through the promotion of entrepreneurship skills and training, the project aims to increase job creation and promote the livelihoods of young people.???
